title_en: Zhejiang Jinhua City Water Supply Company v. Jiangxi Sanqingshan Management Committee — dispute over joint venture construction of cable car
ruling_gist_en: Where a party enters into two agreements with different parties successively on the same subject matter, and the contents of both agreements do not violate any mandatory provisions of laws or administrative regulations and legally meet the conditions for contract effectiveness, the latter agreement shall not be deemed invalid merely because the former agreement is valid, nor shall there be found any difference in validity between the two agreements. If a party, by performing one agreement, breaches the other agreement as against the other party to that other agreement, it shall be liable for breach of contract.
keywords_en: civil; dispute over joint operation contract; second instance; Supreme People's Court; Zhejiang Province; Jiangxi Province; legal person; state organ; Contract Law; validity of two agreements successively signed on the same subject matter; whether validity of former agreement renders latter agreement invalid; determination of liability for breach of contract; amended judgment; joint construction of cableway; successive signing of two agreements; government approval issue; dispute over joint construction of cableway with mountain management committee
full_text_en:
Zhejiang Jinhua Water Supply Company v. Sanqingshan Management Committee — joint venture construction of cable car line dispute

【Ruling Summary】

Where a party signs two agreements with different parties in succession regarding the same subject matter, and the contents of both agreements do not violate mandatory provisions of laws or administrative regulations and meet the statutory conditions for validity of a contract, the later agreement shall not be deemed invalid, nor shall there be a difference in validity between the earlier and later agreements, simply because the earlier agreement is valid. If a party, by performing one of the agreements, breaches the contract against the other party under the other agreement, it shall bear liability for breach of contract.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

(2001) Min Er Zhong Zi No. 197

Appellant (Third Party at First Instance): Jiangxi Sanqingshan Cable Car Co., Ltd.

Legal Representative: Chen Bin, Chairman of the Board.

Registered Address: Outside Nanshan, Sanqingshan, Shangrao, Jiangxi

Authorized Agent: Shang Jinquan, Beijing Dacheng Law Firm.

Authorized Agent: Huang Qili, Beijing Dacheng Law Firm.

Respondents (Plaintiffs at First Instance): Zhejiang Jinhua Water Supply General Company. Registered Address: No. 415, Bayi South Street, Jinhua City, Zhejiang Province.

Legal Representative: Wu Lixin, Chairman of the Board.

Authorized Agent: Xu Jiayun, Engineer of the Company.

Authorized Agent: Wen Xingbin, Lawyer of Zhejiang Chuangxin Law Firm.

Respondents (Plaintiffs at First Instance): Hainan Asia Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. Registered Address: Room 1206, International Commercial Building, No. 38 Datong Road, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

Legal Representative: Lou Jin, Chairman of the Board.

Authorized Agent: Zhou Yanrong, Lawyer of Beijing Century Law Firm.

Respondents (Plaintiffs at First Instance): Zhejiang Jinhua Construction Engineering Company. Registered Address: No. 77, Jiefang West Road, Jinhua City, Zhejiang Province.

Legal Representative: Huang Jianhua, General Manager. Authorized Agent: Wen Xingbin, Lawyer of Zhejiang Chuangxin Law Firm.

Original Defendant: Sanqingshan Management Committee. Registered Address: Second Floor, Zhongshan Building, Xinzhou District, Shangrao City, Jiangxi Province.

Legal Representative: Wang Xiaofeng, Director of the Committee.

Authorized Agent: Yu Xiangming, Lawyer of Jiangxi Sida Law Firm.

Original Third Party: Jiangxi Shangrao Jinsha Cable Car Co., Ltd.

Registered Address: Jinsha, Sanqingshan, Shangrao, Jiangxi.

Legal Representative: Wu Lixin, Chairman of the Board.

The appellant, Jiangxi Sanqingshan Cable Car Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Sanqingshan Cable Car Company), appealed against the civil judgment (2001) Gan Min Chu Zi No. 2 of the Jiangxi High People's Court in the case of a joint venture construction of a cable car line dispute with the respondents Zhejiang Jinhua Water Supply General Company, Hainan Asia Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., Zhejiang Jinhua Construction Engineering Company (hereinafter collectively referred to as the three companies including the Water Supply Company), the original defendant Sanqingshan Management Committee (hereinafter referred to as the Sanqingshan Management Committee), and the original third party Jiangxi Shangrao Jinsha Cable Car Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the Jinsha Cable Car Company), and appealed to this Court. This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law, with Judge Jiang Wei as the presiding judge, and Acting Judges Chen Bailing and Lei Jiping participating in the trial, and Clerk Xia Dongxia serving as the recorder. During the trial of this case, the Jiangxi High People's Court, on March 22, 2002, issued a civil ruling (2002) Gan Min Jian Zi No. 22 to retry case (2001) Rao Zhong Fa Min Er Zhong Zi No. 12. Because the outcome of the retrial by the Jiangxi High People's Court would affect this Court's handling of this case, this Court ruled on May 27, 2002 to suspend the proceedings. The Jiangxi High People's Court rendered a civil judgment (2002) Gan Min Zai Zhong Zi No. 12 on May 9, 2004 for the above retrial case. This Court then resumed the trial of this case on June 29, 2004. This case has now been concluded.

The Jiangxi High People's Court found the following facts: Between 1993 and 1995, leaders of the Shangrao area and the Sanqingshan Scenic Area Management Bureau traveled to Jinhua, Zhejiang on multiple occasions to attract investment. The cable car development project from Jinsha to Goddess Peak on Sanqingshan, which is the subject of this dispute, was one of the investment projects promoted by Yushan County and the Shangrao area in Zhejiang. On December 28, 1995, the Jinsha Tourism Development Zone Management Committee of Sanqing Township, Yushan County signed an agreement with the Sanqing Retreat and Vacation Center of Jinhua Development Zone, titled "Agreement on the Preparation for the Construction of the Jinsha Goddess Cable Car." On March 28, 1996, the Yushan County Government approved the development of the Jinsha Cable Car through Document Yufu Zi [1996] No. 035. During this period, in March 1996, the Shangrao Prefectural Committee and Administrative Office decided to rationalize the management system of Sanqingshan, transferring the Sanqingshan Scenic Area, Sanqing Township of Yushan County, and four other villages to the Sanqingshan Management Committee, authorizing the Committee to exercise administrative authority. On May 10 of the same year, the Sanqingshan Management Committee signed an agreement titled "Agreement on the Preparation for the Construction of the Jinsha Cable Car in Sanqing Township" with Zhejiang Jinhua Huang Daxian Co., Ltd., Zhejiang Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, the Eighth Engineering Section of Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, Hainan Asia Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., and individual Peng Dengguo. The agreement stipulated that the Jinsha Cable Car would have a total length of 2,105 meters, a total investment of RMB 13 million, and specified the shareholdings of the parties. To ensure that existing policies were not interrupted due to the institutional adjustment, the Sanqingshan Management Committee, on July 8, 1996, signed an "Agreement on the Establishment of Sanqingshan Jinsha Cable Car Co., Ltd." with the three companies including the Water Supply Company. The agreement stipulated a company capital of RMB 15.3 million, of which RMB 1 million was for Sanqingshan scenic resource shares, and the RMB 13 million in legal person shares were each to be increased by 10% for individual shares. The three companies including the Water Supply Company contributed capital in proportion on July 15, 1996: RMB 550,000, RMB 440,000, and RMB 110,000 respectively. The Sanqing Township Government remitted RMB 110,000 on July 29, 1996, and on behalf of the Sanqingshan Management Committee, contributed RMB 220,000. On July 26, 1996, the Jinsha Cable Car Company was registered and obtained a business license with the approval of the Jiangxi Provincial Administration for Industry and Commerce. The site selection for the Jinsha to Goddess Peak Cable Car was also submitted by the Shangrao area to the Provincial Construction Department in accordance with the approval procedures. In August 1996, the Provincial Construction Department organized experts to inspect and discuss the site selection plan for the Jinsha Cable Car, and then forwarded the plan to the National Ministry of Construction. On January 27, 1997, the Ministry of Construction formally approved the site selection plan through Document Jian Jing Zi (1997) No. 8. On June 4, 1997, June 10, 1998, July 7, 1998, May 18, 1999, May 24, 2000, and September 18, 2000, the Jinsha Cable Car Company submitted multiple reports to the Sanqingshan Management Committee and the Shangrao Area Planning Commission, requesting project approval and commencement of construction, but no approval was granted. Since 1994, the three companies including the Water Supply Company had acquired 116 mu of land in the scenic area, and the Jinsha Cable Car Company had signed an agreement with the Sanqing Township Government to acquire 25 mu of land, paying an advance of RMB 100,000 in land costs. The three companies including the Water Supply Company and the Jinsha Cable Car Company spent approximately RMB 1.3 million on preliminary surveys and preparations, and over RMB 200,000 on other expenses. Direct economic losses were approximately RMB 100,000. On June 6, 1998, Zhejiang Jinhua Water Supply Company, Shen Zengfu of the Eighth Engineering Section of Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, Jiangxi Sanqingshan Tourism Co., Ltd., Jiangxi Sanqingshan Jinsha Tourism Economic Development Co., Ltd., Hainan Asia Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., and Yushan County Sanqingshan Tourism General Company signed an "Agreement on Readjusting the Shareholders and Capital Contributions of Sanqingshan Jinsha Cable Car Co., Ltd.," but this agreement was not actually performed. Thereafter, the Jinsha Cable Car project remained stagnant. As a result, the three companies including the Water Supply Company repeatedly reported to the Jiangxi Provincial Government, Zhejiang Provincial Government, Jinhua Municipal Government, and relevant parties, requesting performance of the agreements. Since 1999, the Jiangxi Provincial Government, Zhejiang Provincial Government, Jinhua Municipal Government, and relevant parties had held multiple coordination meetings, and the former Governor of Jiangxi Province, Shu Shengyou, also gave repeated instructions. On June 1, 1999, the Shangrao Area Administrative Office issued documents Rao Xing Zi [1999] No. 41, 42, and 43, respectively replying to the Jiangxi Provincial Administration for Industry and Commerce, the Jiangxi Provincial Cooperation Office, and the Jiangxi Provincial Construction Department, stating that the registration and establishment of the Jinsha Cable Car Company was a corporate act, and that the main issue was disagreement over the cable car's site selection and construction timeline. The documents also stated that the project had not been fully substantiated and that approval for the project was not granted. On March 20, 2000, the Jiangxi Provincial Office for Foreign Economic and Technical Cooperation reported to the Jiangxi Provincial Government through Document Gan Wai Jing Ban Zi [2000] No. 18, titled "Report on the Coordination Meeting for the Sanqingshan Cable Car Project," requesting that the Jiangxi Provincial Government instruct the Shangrao Administrative Office to approve the project's establishment and commencement of construction before the end of April. On April 7, 2000, the General Office of the Jiangxi Provincial Government approved the report through Document Gan Fu Ting Zi [2000] No. 44, requiring the Shangrao Administrative Office to expedite the handling of all procedures for the project's establishment and construction, and the Provincial Construction Department to provide guidance on cable car construction and scenic area protection during construction. On November 9, 2000, the Jiangxi Provincial Office for Economic and Technical Cooperation, the Jiangxi Provincial Supervision Department, the Jiangxi Provincial Construction Department, and the Commerce and Supervision Office of the General Office of the Jiangxi Provincial Government went to Shangrao City to learn about the implementation of Document Gan Fu Ban [2000] No. 44, and on November 21, 2000, submitted a report to the Jiangxi Provincial Government. The General Office of the Jiangxi Provincial Government then issued a "Handling Opinion on the Issue of the Sanqingshan Jinnv (Goddess) Line Cable Car," requiring the Shangrao Municipal Government to instruct relevant departments to earnestly implement the Jinnv Line contract, treat business people equally, and encourage fair competition. On March 20, 2001, the three companies including the Water Supply Company filed a lawsuit with the Jiangxi High People's Court, requesting that the Sanqingshan Management Committee perform the series of agreements regarding the construction of the Jinsha Cable Car, promptly grant project approval and complete the commencement procedures, and compensate for economic losses of RMB 10.01 million caused by the delay in performing the contract.

The Jiangxi High People's Court further found the following facts: On March 18, 1995, the Sanqingshan Management Committee signed a "Contract for the Construction of a Tourist Cable Car in the Tiyunling Scenic Area of Sanqingshan" with Hong Kong New Sea International Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as New Sea Company), establishing a joint venture Sanqingshan Cable Car Company, and agreed that no second cable car line would be built in the southern part of the Sanqingshan area in Shangrao, Jiangxi, China. On April 8 of the same year, the parties signed a "Supplementary Contract Regarding the Construction of a Tourist Cable Car in the Tiyunling Scenic Area of Sanqingshan," Article 3 of which stipulated that if a second tourist cable car was indeed needed within the Sanqingshan area, it should be invested in and constructed by the registered Sanqingshan Cable Car Company. In February 2001, New Sea Company filed a lawsuit against the Sanqingshan Management Committee in the Xinzhou District People's Court of Shangrao City, Jiangxi Province, arguing that the contracts signed between the Sanqingshan Management Committee and the three companies including the Water Supply Company conflicted with the content of the two contracts signed by New Sea Company, seriously infringing upon its lawful rights and interests, and requested the court to declare the contracts signed between the three companies including the Water Supply Company and the Sanqingshan Management Committee invalid. On May 8, 2001, the Xinzhou District People's Court of Shangrao City rendered a civil judgment (2001) Rao Xin Jing Chu Zi No. 31, supporting New Sea Company's request. The Jinsha Cable Car Company, which participated in the lawsuit as a third party with independent claims, appealed the judgment to the Shangrao Intermediate People's Court. On June 26, 2001, the Shangrao Intermediate People's Court rendered a civil judgment (2001) Rao Zhong Fa Min Er Zhong Zi No. 12, holding that the "Agreement on Readjusting the Shareholders and Capital Contributions of Sanqingshan Jinsha Cable Car Co., Ltd." signed on June 6, 1998, by Zhejiang Jinhua Water Supply General Company, the Eighth Engineering Section of Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, Jiangxi Sanqingshan Tourism Industrial Co., Ltd., Yushan County Sanqingshan Tourism General Company, Jiangxi Sanqingshan Jinsha Tourism Economic Development Co., Ltd., and Hainan Asia Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., replaced the "Agreement on the Establishment of Sanqingshan Jinsha Cable Car Co., Ltd.," and that the Sanqingshan Management Committee was no longer a shareholder of Sanqingshan Jinsha Cable Car Co., Ltd. and was no longer bound by that agreement, and that the agreement no longer existed, thus eliminating the issue of validity or invalidity of the agreement. The judgment therefore affirmed that the "Contract for the Construction of a Tourist Cable Car in the Tiyunling Scenic Area of Sanqingshan" and the "Supplementary Contract" signed between New Sea Company and the Sanqingshan Management Committee were lawful and valid, and set aside the provision in the judgment of the Xinzhou District People's Court of Shangrao City that declared the agreement signed between the Sanqingshan Management Committee and the shareholders of the Jinsha Cable Car Company invalid. On December 28, 2000, Yang Shenquan, a director of New Sea Company (Registration No. 496180), submitted a "Application for Deregistration of a Non-Operating Private Company" to the Companies Registry of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government. On May 11, 2001, the Hong Kong Companies Registry published a notice announcing the deregistration of New Sea Company (Registration No. 496180) on that day, and the company was dissolved upon deregistration.

The Jiangxi High People's Court held at trial that the relevant agreements signed between the Sanqingshan Management Committee and the three companies including the Water Supply Company had qualified parties, clear and specific content, the scenic spot selection had been reported level by level in accordance with relevant regulations and had obtained approval from the relevant state authorities, and the parties to the agreements had partially performed the agreements, thus the agreements were lawful and valid. The Sanqingshan Management Committee's argument, based on the relevant clauses of the contract signed with New Sea Company (Registration No. 496180) and the supplementary contract, to deny the clearly contented agreements signed between the three companies including the Water Supply Company and the Sanqingshan Management Committee, could not be sustained. Moreover, New Sea Company had been deregistered on May 11, 2001, and the subject of rights no longer existed. The Sanqingshan Management Committee's claim that it did not fulfill its investment obligations under the agreement of July 8, 1996, was inconsistent with the facts, and its argument, based on the agreement of June 6, 1998, that it had voluntarily waived its qualification as an investor, lacked legal basis. The Sanqingshan Management Committee had the authority to approve and establish construction projects. Its failure to perform the agreements, causing a delay of up to five years without justification, should be compensated for losses incurred by the three companies including the Water Supply Company. The request by the three companies including the Water Supply Company and the Jinsha Cable Car Company for performance of the agreements should be supported. However, the expected profits claimed in the request for compensation for losses should not be calculated because no investment had been made. The properties already invested by the three companies including the Water Supply Company, which were under their control, should not be included in the scope of compensation for losses. Unnecessary travel and other expenses incurred by the three companies including the Water Supply Company to maintain the status quo should be compensated by the Sanqingshan Management Committee as appropriate. Pursuant to Articles 44, 60, and 107 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China, the court rendered the following judgment: 1. The agreements regarding the preparation and establishment of the Jinsha Cable Car and the company, signed by the three companies including the Water Supply Company and the Sanqingshan Management Committee, are lawful and valid and shall continue to be performed; 2. The Sanqingshan Management Committee, for breach of contract, shall compensate the three companies including the Water Supply Company for losses in the amount of RMB 100,000; 3. The other claims of the three companies including the Water Supply Company are dismissed. The case acceptance fee of RMB 60,060 shall be borne by the Sanqingshan Management Committee in the amount of RMB 40,000, and by the three companies including the Water Supply Company in the amount of RMB 20,060.

Sanqingshan Cable Car Company, dissatisfied with the above civil judgment of the Jiangxi High People's Court, appealed to this Court, arguing: (1) The original judgment of this case contradicts an effective judgment, and its findings of fact are unclear, the evidence is insufficient, and it violates relevant laws and regulations. The effective civil judgment (2002) Gan Min Zai Zhong Zi No. 12 of the Jiangxi High People's Court has already ordered the Sanqingshan Management Committee to perform its contract with Hong Kong New Sea Company regarding the construction of the second cable car line, and according to the contract, it should be specifically invested in and constructed by Sanqingshan Cable Car Company. However, the judgment of this case orders the Sanqingshan Management Committee to perform the contract with the three companies including the Water Supply Company regarding the same cable car line, which contradicts the effective judgment. (2) The original judgment erred in finding that the relevant agreements signed between the three companies including the Water Supply Company and the Sanqingshan Management Committee were valid. The Eighth Engineering Section of Zhejiang Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, the Sanqingshan Management Committee, and the Sanqing Township Government lacked the capacity to enter into such agreements, and the agreements signed are invalid. (3) The approval of the cable car site selection by the relevant authorities does not mean that the project has been approved, nor does it mean that such approval was specifically aimed at implementing the agreements. It is not a basis for determining the validity of any agreement. (4) Whether the parties to an agreement have performed the agreement is not a condition for the legality and validity of the agreement. The original judgment confused the legal relationship between the validity of a contract and the performance of a contract. (5) The original judgment's denial of the Sanqingshan Management Committee's defense on the ground that New Sea Company was deregistered on May 11, 2001 and the subject of rights no longer existed, cannot be sustained. (6) The procedure of the original judgment was unlawful. Sanqingshan Cable Car Company participated in the proceedings at first instance as a third party with independent claims, presenting its own claims, and the judgment should have addressed the appellant's claims. The original judgment in this case made no finding or judgment regarding the appellant's claims, which obviously violated procedural rules. (7) The dispute in this case had already been separately litigated by Hong Kong New Sea Company. During that litigation, Jinsha Cable Car Company had already participated as a third party with independent claims, and the court of first instance engaged in repeated adjudication. (8) After the court of first instance accepted this case, Sanqingshan Cable Car Company filed a written objection to jurisdiction, but the court of first instance did not make a ruling in accordance with the law and instead rendered a judgment directly, violating Article 140 of the Civil Procedure Law. (9) The trial of this case omitted necessary parties. Since the issue of the validity or invalidity of the agreements and whether they should continue to be performed was being determined, the relevant parties to the agreements should have been joined as parties; otherwise, there would be serious defects in the subject matter of the litigation and the substance, preventing the full protection of the lawful rights and interests of the parties. (10) The original judgment erred in the application of law. The original judgment applied Articles 44 and 60 of the Contract Law to the issue of the validity of the agreements signed between the Sanqingshan Management Committee and the three companies including the Water Supply Company, which lacked a factual and evidentiary basis, and thus misapplied the law.

Appellees Water Supply Company and the other two companies argued in defense: (1) The original judgment is not contradictory to the civil judgment (2002) Gan Min Zai Zhong Zi No. 12. First, the said civil judgment (2002) Gan Min Zai Zhong Zi No. 12 is erroneous. The "Contract for the Construction of a Tourist Cable Car in the Tiyunling Scenic Area of Mount Sanqing" and the so-called "Supplementary Contract" confirmed as valid in that case actually violated the Anti-Unfair Competition Law, and moreover, the approval procedures required under Article 3 of the Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture Law of the PRC were not fulfilled, rendering them invalid. Second, the case underlying civil judgment (2002) Gan Min Zai Zhong Zi No. 12 and the present case are two separate lawsuits with no conflict or contradiction whatsoever. The two cases seek confirmation of two different contracts. (2) The relevant agreements entered into among the Eighth Work Area of Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, the Sanqingshan Management Committee, and the Sanqing Township People's Government have qualified parties. First, the Eighth Work Area of Jinhua Construction Engineering Company was subsequently ratified by Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, and when the agreements were originally signed, the signature of Shen Zengfu (individual) of the Eighth Work Area was affixed thereto. Therefore, whether it is Shen Zengfu as an individual or Jinhua Construction Engineering Company as a corporate entity, both are lawful and qualified parties as investors. Second, the Sanqing Township People's Government is an organization integrating the functions of a township and a state farm. It exercises both the functions of a grassroots government and the dual authority of a farm as an economic organization, and thus it possesses the requisite party qualification. (3) The original judgment's statement that "the selection of scenic spots had been reported level by level in accordance with relevant regulations, had obtained approval from the relevant state authorities, and the parties to the agreements had partially performed in accordance with the agreements" is a correct finding of fact; it does not purport to be the sole basis for the validity of the agreements. (4) The original judgment did not "confuse the legal relationships of contract validity and contract performance," nor did it "contrary to the facts, find that unperformed agreements were partially performed." (5) The original judgment contained no procedural irregularities. Sanqingshan Cable Car Co., Ltd. did not raise any of its own claims in the original trial of this case; in fact, it participated in this case as a third party with no independent claims. This case is an action for confirmation of a contract, and the appellant is not a party to the contract at all. Having no right to raise its own claims, the court naturally had no need to render a judgment on them. (6) The court of first instance did not "violate the provisions regarding repeated adjudication" in accepting this case. The Shangrao case and the present case confirm two different lawsuits. (7) Sanqingshan Cable Car Co., Ltd., as a third party with no independent claims in the original trial, was entirely without the right to raise a jurisdictional challenge under the relevant provisions. Therefore, after it raised its objection, the court of first instance orally dismissed it in court. At that time, the judge inquired whether Sanqingshan Cable Car Co., Ltd. wished to appeal, and the appellant replied: "Forget it, no appeal." (8) This case is not a necessary joint action, and there was absolutely no need to add other parties in a judgment confirming the validity of a contract, as it had already "comprehensively protected the lawful rights and interests of the parties." (9) The application of law in the original judgment is entirely correct. This case is primarily an action for confirmation of a civil contract. Applying Articles 44 and 60 of the Contract Law to confirm the validity of the contract is entirely correct. (10) Jiangxi Sanqingshan Cable Car Co., Ltd. has no right to appeal in this case. This case is primarily an action for confirmation of a contract. The appellant is neither a party to the contract nor a bearer of obligations under this case. It participated in the original trial as a third party with no independent claims. Therefore, pursuant to the provisions of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC and the judicial interpretations of the Supreme People's Court, it has no right whatsoever to appeal this case, much less a right to request a declaration of invalidity of an agreement entered into between others.

In addition to confirming the facts found by the original trial, this court has ascertained the following during the second instance: 1. The main content of the "Agreement on the Preparation for the Construction of the Jinsha Nüshen Cable Car" signed on December 28, 1995, between the Yushan County Sanqingshan Jinsha Tourism Development Zone Management Committee and the Jinhua Development Zone Sanqing Rest and Holiday Center, as mentioned in the original judgment, was that the two parties set forth a preliminary cooperation intention and agreed that each party would be responsible for contacting investment entities in Jiangxi and Zhejiang respectively. 2. The main content of the "Agreement on the Preparation for the Construction of the Sanqing Township Jinsha Cable Car" signed on May 10, 1995, between the Sanqingshan Management Committee and Zhejiang Jinhua Huang Daxian Co., Ltd., Zhejiang Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, the Eighth Engineering Area of Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, Hainan Asia Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., and Peng Dengguo as an individual, as mentioned in the original judgment, was that the parties agreed to jointly invest in the construction of a cable car from Sanqing Township, Jinsha, to Nüshen Peak. The total length of the cable car was 2,105 meters. Jinhua Construction Engineering Company was entrusted as the general contractor for the works and costs, with a total construction cost of RMB 13 million, on a profit-and-loss responsibility basis; the quality was to comply with relevant national codes and standards; the cable car construction was required to be completed within one year.

During the second instance of this court, the Jiangxi High People's Court, by civil ruling (2002) Gan Min Jian Zi No. 22 dated March 22, 2002, found that the civil judgment (2001) Rao Zhong Fa Zi Min Er Zhong Zi No. 12 of the Shangrao Intermediate People's Court had unclear findings of fact, insufficient evidence, and improper disposition, and ordered the case to be retried by the Jiangxi High People's Court. On May 9, 2004, the Jiangxi High People's Court rendered civil judgment (2002) Gan Min Zai Zhong Zi No. 12 in that case. The changes made by that retrial judgment to the civil judgment (2001) Rao Zhong Fa Zi Min Er Zhong Zi No. 12 of the Shangrao Intermediate People's Court mainly included two aspects: (1) Because the original plaintiff in that case, Hong Kong Xinhai International Group Co., Ltd., was dissolved during the proceedings and lost its party qualification, the retrial judgment changed the party to the proceedings to Chen Xin, a shareholder of that company, to replace the company. (2) The first item of the operative part of the civil judgment (2001) Rao Zhong Fa Zi Min Er Zhong Zi No. 12 of the Shangrao Intermediate People's Court, which had affirmed the validity of the "Contract for the Construction of a Tourist Cable Car in the Tiyunling Scenic Area of Mount Sanqing" and the "Supplementary Contract to the Contract for the Construction of a Tourist Cable Car in the Tiyunling Scenic Area of Mount Sanqing" entered into between Hong Kong Xinhai International Group Co., Ltd. and the Sanqingshan Management Committee, and ordered both parties to continue performance, was changed to only affirming the validity of those two contracts, without directly ordering both parties to continue performance.

We hold that the contents of the "Agreement on the Preparation for the Construction of the Sanqing Township Jinsha Cable Car" and the "Agreement on the Formation of Sanqingshan Jinsha Cable Car Co., Ltd.," for which the Water Supply Company and the other two companies sought confirmation of validity from the court of first instance, do not violate the mandatory provisions of laws and administrative regulations. None of the parties argued that the above contracts did not represent their true intentions. Pursuant to the principle for determining contract validity established by Article 3 of this Court's "Interpretation (I) on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China" and Article 52 of the Contract Law, the above contracts should be determined to be lawful and valid. As to the appellant Sanqingshan Cable Car Company's argument that the Eighth Engineering Area of Zhejiang Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, the Sanqingshan Management Committee, and the Sanqing Township Government lacked the capacity to enter into civil agreements, upon review by this court, during the development and construction of the Sanqingshan Scenic and Historic Area, both the Sanqing Township Government and the Sanqingshan Management Committee had functions such as investment attraction and certain administrative management functions. The civil contracts they entered into within the scope of their authority concerning development and construction projects in the Sanqingshan Scenic and Historic Area should be determined to be valid. Although the Eighth Engineering Area of Zhejiang Jinhua Construction Engineering Company was an internal unit of Zhejiang Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, since the contracts it signed were ratified by Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, their validity is not affected. Therefore, the appellant Sanqingshan Cable Car Company's appeal argument that the contracts in dispute in this case are invalid is not supported by this court.

In the relevant contract between the Sanqingshan Management Committee and Xinhai Company, the parties agreed that if a second tourist cable car (the first cable car refers to the Tiyunling Scenic Area aerial tourist cable car already constructed and put into operation) was indeed necessary to be built within the Sanqingshan area, it should be invested in and constructed by Sanqingshan Cable Car Company. The civil judgment (2002) Gan Min Zai Zhong Zi No. 12 of the Jiangxi High People's Court, which has become effective, affirmed the validity of that contract. After the above agreement was signed, the Sanqingshan Management Committee again signed the "Agreement on the Preparation for the Construction of the Sanqing Township Jinsha Cable Car" and the "Agreement on the Formation of Sanqingshan Jinsha Cable Car Co., Ltd." with the Water Supply Company and the other two companies, expressly stipulating that the Water Supply Company and the other two companies would construct the Sanqingshan Jinsha Cable Car, and specifically setting out the cable car route, length, quality standards, construction funds, construction period, and other related content.

Although the contract between the Sanqingshan Management Committee and the Water Supply Company and the other two companies was signed later, because the contract signed earlier between the Sanqingshan Management Committee and Xinhai Company only stipulated that the second cable car should be exclusively invested in and constructed by Sanqingshan Cable Car Company, but the parties had not yet specifically agreed on the cable car route, length, quality standards, construction funds, construction period, and other content, at the time the Sanqingshan Management Committee signed the contract with the Water Supply Company and the other two companies, the second Sanqingshan cable car had not actually been invested in and constructed by Sanqingshan Cable Car Company. Therefore, with respect to the subject matter of the contract, the later-signed contract does not constitute objective impossibility from the outset. Moreover, there are no invalidating factors in the content of that contract or in the expression of the parties' intentions. Consequently, the contract between the Sanqingshan Management Committee and the Water Supply Company is not invalid for being signed later, nor does it differ in validity from the earlier-signed contract. The Water Supply Company, the other two companies, and Hong Kong Xinhai International Group Co., Ltd. may each request the Sanqingshan Management Committee to perform the contract based on their respective contractual relationships. If the Sanqingshan Management Committee performs the contract it signed with the Water Supply Company and the other two companies, i.e., allowing the Water Supply Company and the other two companies to invest in and construct the second cable car, then in fact this will cause Sanqingshan Cable Car Company to lose the opportunity to construct the second cable car. In terms of legal consequences, this may constitute a breach of contract by the Sanqingshan Management Committee towards Xinhai Company. In this regard, Sanqingshan Cable Car Company may lawfully request the Sanqingshan Management Committee to assume liability for breach of contract, but it cannot, in this case, request a declaration of invalidity of the contract signed between the Sanqingshan Management Committee and the Water Supply Company and the other two companies. Therefore, the appellant Sanqingshan Cable Car Company's argument, based on the fact that the civil judgment (2002) Gan Min Zai Zhong Zi No. 12 of the court of first instance in this case, which has become effective, had affirmed the validity of the contract between Xinhai Company and the Sanqingshan Management Committee, to contest the validity of the contract between the Water Supply Company and the other two companies and the Sanqingshan Management Committee, lacks legal basis and is not supported by this court. Although when Xinhai Company filed its lawsuit with the Xinzhou District People's Court of Shangrao City, Jiangxi Province, it sought confirmation of the validity of both the contract between Xinhai Company and the Sanqingshan Management Committee and the contract between the Water Supply Company and the other two companies and the Sanqingshan Management Committee, that case was subsequently retried, and the final judgment (i.e., civil judgment (2002) Gan Min Zai Zhong Zi No. 12) did not adjudicate the issue of the validity of the contract between the Water Supply Company and the other two companies and the Sanqingshan Management Committee. Therefore, it was procedurally lawful for the court of first instance in this case to accept this case and determine the validity of the contract between the Water Supply Company and the other two companies and the Sanqingshan Management Committee. The appellant Sanqingshan Cable Car Company's appeal arguments that the first instance of this case constituted repeated litigation and that the original judgment contradicts the already effective judgment are not supported by this court.

In this case, the series of contracts signed between the Water Supply Company and the other two companies and the Sanqingshan Management Committee only established rights and obligations between the contracting parties; they did not create rights or obligations for Sanqingshan Cable Car Company. As a party outside the contractual relationship, Sanqingshan Cable Car Company has no independent claim regarding the validity of a contractual relationship between others that does not involve its own interests, nor regarding issues of litigation jurisdiction. Although Sanqingshan Cable Car Company was notified by the court of first instance to participate in the proceedings, because it did not have the procedural rights of a party and the original judgment did not order it to bear any liability, its appeal arguments alleging procedural violations, such as that the court of first instance failed to render a judgment on its claims and failed to issue a written ruling on its jurisdictional challenge, are not supported by this court. The original judgment ordered the Sanqingshan Management Committee to compensate the Water Supply Company and the other two companies for losses in the amount of RMB 100,000. The Sanqingshan Management Committee did not appeal. Pursuant to Article 35 of this Court's "Several Provisions on Issues Concerning the Reform of Civil and Economic Trial Methods," this court will not adjudicate this issue, and the relevant part of the original judgment is directly affirmed.

In summary, the appeal arguments of Sanqingshan Cable Car Company lack sufficient factual and legal basis and are not supported by this court. The original judgment in this case found the facts clearly and correctly determined that the series of contracts signed between the Water Supply Company and the other two companies and the Sanqingshan Management Committee are valid and ordered the Sanqingshan Management Committee to perform its contractual obligations. However, since the commencement and actual performance of the cable car construction contract require the approval and permission of the relevant administrative authorities, and such conduct is not subject to adjustment by civil legal relations, to avoid conflict between the enforcement of this judgment and administrative licensing powers, the original judgment should be appropriately modified. Accordingly, pursuant to Article 153, Paragraph 1, Items (1) and (3) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, this court hereby renders the following judgment:

1. Uphold Items 2 and 3 of the operative part of the civil judgment (2001) Gan Min Chu Zi No. 2 of the Jiangxi High People's Court;

2. Modify Item 1 of the operative part of the said civil judgment as follows: The "Agreement on the Preparation for the Construction of the Sanqing Township Jinsha Cable Car" and the "Agreement on the Formation of Sanqingshan Jinsha Cable Car Co., Ltd." entered into among Zhejiang Jinhua Water Supply General Company, Hainan Asia Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., Zhejiang Jinhua Construction Engineering Company, and the Sanqingshan Management Committee are lawful and valid.

Court acceptance fee for the first instance shall be borne as determined in the original judgment. Court acceptance fee for the second instance is RMB 50, to be borne by Jiangxi Sanqingshan Cable Car Co., Ltd.

This judgment is final.
